displayName: Baseline - Android Enterprise (Fully Managed) - Launcher and Branding
description: Microsoft Launcher configuration for single-user, corporate-owned fully managed Android devices. Makes Launcher the managed home experience, applies the tenant-specific wallpaper image, prevents wallpaper and launcher-layout changes, disables the personalised feed, keeps the dock visible, and places search at the bottom. Before deployment, assign Microsoft Launcher as a Required Managed Google Play app and define the CIPP custom variable androidwallpaperurl as a direct publicly reachable HTTPS image URL.
